NEET Re-Exam Irregularities: Dozens Arrested in Bihar

Authorities in Bihar have arrested approximately 30 individuals in connection with irregularities during the NEET-UG re-examination. The arrests include exam center staff for violating verification norms and impersonators attempting to take the test for registered candidates. This action follows reports of a cheating racket aimed at undermining the integrity of the re-test.
